svg.title: Walking checkpoint 3000 behavior and CPU transfer
svg.desc: Forward speed, lateral speed, yaw speed and trunk tilt for identical exported policy bytes. Standard native play and nominal CPU BAM both fail full behavior acceptance. Velocity curves use 0.2-second means.
